name: pinverse
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::pinverse(Tensor self, float rcond=1e-15) -> Tensor. Computes a Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse without mutating or aliasing self. Tests cover rectangular, square, batched, noncontiguous, empty, rank-deficient, ill-conditioned and nonfinite inputs, explicit rcond values, large batches, Moore-Penrose identities, supported float32, invalid rank/dtypes, and the implementation's explicit autograd rejection.
